name: Biochemical Charge
bonus: Comprehensively increases the Biochemical Troops Attack/HP/Defense by 4%. The effect increases by 20% Cross-Nation.

name: Giant Weapons
bonus: Get the Giant Weapons special effect. In the first 20 seconds of a battle, increase the Attack of Source Spirit, Empress and Warplane by 2%.

name: Strong Will
bonus: Reduces the Damage taken by your Melee Troops by 0.8% and reduces the Attack of the enemy LR/MR Troops by 2.6%.

name: Rocket Turret
bonus: Summon the Rocket Turret in battles with Commanders. The turret launches attacks at the enemy Troop with the largest number every 2 seconds. Damage is equal to the number of your surviving Troops x3.

name: Nano Swarm
bonus: Nano Swarm increases all your Troops HP/Defense by 1.5%. In battles with Commanders, randomly deals Damage equal to the number of surviving Troops x3 to 3 enemy Troops every 10 sec. Prioritises units with shields and increases the Damage dealt to shielded units by 20%.

name: Brilliant Things
bonus: Increase all of your Troops Attack/HP/Defense by 1.2%.
